summary: Quartzsea Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed a Form 8-K solely to postpone its Extraordinary General Meeting from June 16, 2026, 4:00 p.m. ET, to June 18, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET. The filing is a routine procedural update and does not disclose any de-SPAC transaction, business combination, redemption, or other substantive corporate event. No deal terms, advisor, or recommendation are mentioned. This is a mechanical scheduling change with no special-situation implications.
